name: Day in the Life
description: Follows one clearly fictional business owner through a working day: morning bookings, a walk-in, a client's deposit paid by transfer with proof of payment, confirming it, and the balance at the end of the day. Mixes a day timeline, character scenes and product footage. Includes a vertical social cut.

scenes.title: Meet the owner
scenes.guidance: Introduce one fictional owner and say plainly that they are made up. Open on a concrete moment from their morning and the question the day answers. No statistics.

scenes.title: The day ahead
scenes.guidance: Lay out the day the video follows, as times of day. Each event becomes a scene.

scenes.title: Morning bookings
scenes.guidance: Where the owner starts the day in Iker, named as the product names it. Say the footage uses made-up data.

scenes.title: A walk-in
scenes.guidance: A client arrives without a booking. Show Add walk-in, naming each field as the product does.

scenes.title: A deposit by transfer
scenes.guidance: A fictional client books from the link, transfers the deposit to the owner's own account and uploads proof of payment. Say that Iker does not take or hold the money.

scenes.title: Confirming it
scenes.guidance: The owner checks the proof and decides: Confirm booking or Reject payment. Nothing counts as income until it is confirmed.

scenes.title: The rest of the payment
scenes.guidance: The client pays the balance and the owner records it on the same booking. Show Paid so far and Balance remaining.

scenes.title: End of the day
scenes.guidance: Answer the hook's question with what the owner now has. Include the limits. No unsupported numbers or promised outcomes.

scenes.title: Next step
scenes.guidance: One next step, using the site's own call to action.

scenes.title: Hook
scenes.guidance: The fictional owner and the question of the day, in one or two sentences. Say they are made up.

scenes.title: The day
scenes.guidance: The day in three or four beats, one short sentence each.

scenes.title: In Iker
scenes.guidance: One screen from Iker showing the balance on a booking. Say it is made-up data.

scenes.title: Closing time
scenes.guidance: What the owner knows at the end of the day, in one line.
